suite.doc:
KTFL - MIRO invoice entry robot
Picks invoices with status = MATCHED from PostgreSQL (written by the invoice extractor) and enters them in MIRO: 1. Basic data: date, reference -> PO -> then Calculate tax, Tax code (invoices.tax_code), Business Place + Section, Text (first line item) 2. Tick ONLY rows whose "Reference Document" = invoice GRN -> HSN/SAC of those rows = DB HSN (changed in the cell if different) 3. Amount = invoice total -> balance 0? else Details tab: Doc. Type by plant, Unpl. Del. Csts = balance 4. Simulate -> CHECK: exit | PARK: park | POST: post
MIRO_MODE = CHECK (default, nothing saved) | PARK | POST Run: run_miro.bat or robot --outputdir output tasks\miro_posting.robot

errors.msg: MIRO_MODE=POST - invoices WILL be posted in SAP
